picks.title: Coinbase Denies Systems Breach, Cites Amplitude Contact-Data Incident
picks.summary: The exchange says customer funds were unaffected and it is notifying impacted users and regulators.

picks.title: Japan s GMO urges customers to shut down PCs amid ransomware threat
picks.summary: The GMO Group has urged customers to disconnect their systems from the internet and shut down computers after a threat actor who breached the company s Onamae Desktop Cloud threatened to launch a ransomware attack today. [...]

picks.title: UNM Health ransomware attack disrupts patient care, surgeries
picks.summary: The University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center disclosed a cyberattack that caused system outages and disrupted patient care and academic activities. [...]

picks.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
picks.summary: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone s hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

picks.title: Tranche Vault on Avalanche Drained of 1.01 Million USDC
picks.summary: Blockaid says a flash loan let the attacker mint inflated tranche shares and redeem the vault s USDC. A balance check showed none left in the identified contract.

picks.title: US Charges Six in Alleged Madagascar NFT Wallet-Draining Scheme
picks.summary: An FBI affidavit estimates at least $516,695 in losses across 74 victim-linked wallets and describes unlimited USDT spending approvals.

picks.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi s ability to offer betting there
Crypto.com and OG.com launch US crypto perps with up to 5x leverage
picks.summary: The contracts have no expiration date and allow traders to bet on crypto prices rising or falling.

picks.title: How Much Can Semiconductor Models Hide?
picks.summary: Advanced packaging requires models to cross company boundaries without exposing proprietary processes, but hiding too much can make the prediction break down. The post How Much Can Semiconductor Models Hide? appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering .
